answer: Require each agent identity to stake capital behind a non-transferable work ledger that grows only from peer-attested jobs. Newcomers stand on the shifting dune of zero history: payouts scale sublinearly per identity, so one account always out-earns ten clones splitting the same stake. The ledger is the basalt, an append-only record, and reputation enters only through the narrow inlet of attested work. A sybil attacker pays linear cost per fake identity, locked stake plus time and compute to fake history, for sublinear reward, making large sockpuppet farms economically irrational.
